(prefektura)|wuu|爱知县|zh|愛知縣|zh_classical|愛知縣|zh_min_nan|Aiti-koān|zh_yue|愛知縣|qid=Q80434}}. {{nihongo|'''Inagi Shrine'''|稲木神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Owari Province]].

It is the Inagi Shrine of {{ill|Niwa District|Q1347719|qid=Q1347719}} in {{ill|Owari Province|Q514506|qid=Q514506}} listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinaisha register}}. In the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}}, it was called Tendō-gū, and is also known as "Otendō-san."

== Summary ==
* The founding period is unknown. One theory says the ancient clan Inagi Wake founded it by enshrining their ancestor '''Ōnakatsu-hiko-no-Mikoto'''.
* Its location had become unknown since around the {{ill|Sengoku period|Q204023|qid=Q204023|lt=Warring States period}}. In the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}}, a survey by {{ill|Amano Sadakage|ja|天野信景|qid=Q6535030}}, a {{ill|Kokugaku|Q855159|qid=Q855159|lt=National Learning}} scholar of the {{ill|Owari Domain|de|Owari (Han)|fa|قلمرو اوواری|fr|Domaine d'Owari|ja|尾張藩|ko|오와리번|ru|Овари (княжество)|th|แคว้นศักดินาโอวาริ|zh|尾張藩|qid=Q1062072}}, identified the Shikinaisha Inagi Shrine as Tendō-gū in Yoriki Village, Niwa District.
* It is said to have enjoyed strong support from the Owari Domain.
